implementation_separation.problem: One short market entry filled after price had already crossed the unchanged structural stop, leaving the contingent stop on the wrong side of the actual entry.
implementation_separation.fix: The NautilusTrader strategy now immediately flattens any actual entry fill that is not between the unchanged causal stop and target; it never re-anchors alpha geometry to the later fill.

one_variable_ablation.conclusion: OI contraction filtered some noise but was not the source of alpha; removing it increased frequency while materially worsening expectancy.

largest_failure_factor: The detector treated the sign of a 480-minute net return as a complete parent auction and treated any aged pivot in its discount/premium half as post-displacement internal liquidity. Most selected pools were unrelated legacy pivots rather than liquidity formed by and subordinate to a causal accepted break.
valid_components: Causal pivot observation with right-hand confirmation and first-penetration consumption.
Non-climactic reclaim relation requiring confirmation displacement not to exceed the interruption.
Actual-fill lifecycle guard preserving the 3% NAV risk contract without changing stop or target logic.
next_hypothesis: A continuation state must begin with an accepted causal external-pool break. The only retest level eligible for the next scenario is the broken pool itself or a pivot formed after that break; arbitrary pre-existing pivots inside a net-return range are excluded.
